BiblicalUsage: Whosoever falleth not down and worshippeth shall the same hour be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace, and Daniel was cast into the den of lions.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe men cast down what they cannot bend, and God casts down the thrones themselves.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
